# OSRMPlus

> Routing, distance matrices, and fleet optimization API.

OSRMPlus is a cloud API for road network routing. You send coordinates, you get
back routes, distance matrices, and optimized vehicle plans. It is built on OSRM
and is fully compatible with OSRM clients.

Base URL: https://api.osrmplus.com
Authentication: x-api-key header or Authorization: Bearer header
Coordinates: lng,lat (GET endpoints) or [lng, lat] arrays (POST endpoints)

## Install

Python: pip install osrmplus
JavaScript: npm install osrmplus

## Python example

```python
from osrmplus import Client
client = Client("your_api_key")
route = client.route([(74.3436, 31.5497), (74.2650, 31.4700)])
matrix = client.matrix(coordinates=[(74.34, 31.55), (74.27, 31.47), (74.30, 31.50)])
plan = client.optimize(
    vehicles=[{"id": 1, "start": [74.3436, 31.5497], "capacity": [20]}],
    jobs=[
        {"id": 1, "location": [74.2650, 31.4700], "delivery": [5]},
        {"id": 2, "location": [74.3000, 31.5000], "delivery": [8]},
    ],
)
```

## JavaScript example

```javascript
import { OSRMPlus } from "osrmplus";
const client = new OSRMPlus("your_api_key");
const route = await client.route([[74.3436, 31.5497], [74.265, 31.47]]);
const matrix = await client.matrix({ coordinates: [[74.34, 31.55], [74.27, 31.47]] });
const plan = await client.optimize({
    vehicles: [{ id: 1, start: [74.3436, 31.5497], capacity: [20] }],
    jobs: [{ id: 1, location: [74.265, 31.47], delivery: [5] }],
});
```

## curl example

```bash
curl "https://api.osrmplus.com/route/v1/driving/74.3436,31.5497;74.2650,31.4700" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY"

curl "https://api.osrmplus.com/table/v1/driving/74.34,31.55;74.27,31.47;74.30,31.50" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY"

curl -X POST "https://api.osrmplus.com/vrp" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vehicles":[{"id":1,"start":[74.34,31.55],"capacity":[20]}],"jobs":[{"id":1,"location":[74.27,31.47],"delivery":[5]}]}'
```

## Endpoints

GET /route/v1/driving/{lng,lat;lng,lat} - point-to-point route
GET /table/v1/driving/{coords} - distance and duration matrix
GET /nearest/v1/driving/{lng,lat} - snap coordinate to nearest road
GET /match/v1/driving/{coords} - match GPS traces to roads
POST /vrp - multi-vehicle fleet optimization
POST /tsp - shortest round trip
POST /optimize - VRP with sensible defaults

## Route response shape

{ "code": "Ok", "routes": [{ "distance": 12453.2, "duration": 847.3, "geometry": "...", "legs": [...] }] }

## Matrix response shape

{ "code": "Ok", "durations": [[0, 234.5], [234.5, 0]], "distances": [[0, 3200], [3200, 0]] }

## VRP request shape

{ "vehicles": [{ "id": 1, "start": [lng, lat], "capacity": [20] }], "jobs": [{ "id": 1, "location": [lng, lat], "delivery": [5], "time_windows": [[start, end]], "service": 300 }] }

## VRP response shape

{ "code": "Ok", "routes": [{ "vehicle": 1, "steps": [{ "type": "start" }, { "type": "job", "id": 1 }, { "type": "end" }] }], "unassigned": [] }

## Error codes

401 api_key_required - no key sent
401 api_key_invalid - key not recognized
403 region_not_licensed - coordinates outside your regions
402 quota_exceeded - monthly limit reached
429 rate_limit_exceeded - too many requests per second

## Pricing

Free: 50K matrix elements/mo, 1K routing calls/mo, 1 region, $0
Growth: 500K elements/mo, 10K calls/mo, 2 regions, $79/mo
Scale: 5M elements/mo, 100K calls/mo, all regions, $299/mo
Enterprise: unlimited, custom pricing
